encoding.originals: Preserved unchanged in source directory; SHA-256 and dimensions recorded below.

audit.scope: Every current file re-inventoried, hashed and visually reviewed. Selections rebuilt independently of the previous manifest.
audit.selectionAuthority: products is the current source selection; history is archival. Audit mappings and deployed assets are reported separately.
audit.countingPolicy: Contact/collage count includes the two duplicate copies. The 22 collages + 4 unrelated posters + 3 canonical single-product posters + 63 clean standalone photographs partition all 92 files. Exact duplicate count means extra copies, not every member. Posters may be selected as standalone source candidates but are flagged and never disguised as clean photography.
audit.similarityMethod: 63-bit DCT pHash, 64-bit dHash and grayscale SSIM at 128x128. Candidate pairs: pHash <= 12 OR dHash <= 10; human review decides duplication. Theme variants and similar subjects are not automatically duplicates.
